description: This file defines the Shipping model class within the OpenCart e-commerce platform. The class calculates and adds shipping costs to the total order amount, considering applicable taxes and session data related to the shipping method.

classes.name: Shipping
classes.description: A model class responsible for calculating shipping totals for the order, including taxes and integrating with session data.

methods.name: getTotal
methods.description: Calculates the total shipping cost, adds it to the overall totals, and updates taxes based on the shipping method's tax class.
